title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.20637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Static analyzers have been widely adopted for vulnerability detection in C/C++ programs. Query-based static analyzers (e.g., CodeQL) encode vulnerable code patterns in detection queries and match them against source code. However, existing queries still suffer from false positives (FPs, incorrectly flagging benign code as vulnerable) and false negatives (FNs, missing real vulnerabilities). We present ARQ, an agentic framework that automatically refines C/C++ CodeQL queries using execution-grounded evidence from synthesized C/C++ programs. Our key insight is that a synthesized program exposes a query's weakness whenever its execution disagrees with the query's verdict. If the program is genuinely vulnerable but the query stays silent, the query has an FN weakness; if the program is safe but the query fires anyway, it has an FP weakness. ARQ then runs an LLM-based refinement loop that repairs the query using these disagreements as ground

translated_title: ARQ：面向C/C++漏洞检测的智能体CodeQL查询优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20637v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：静态分析器已被广泛用于C/C++程序中的漏洞检测。基于查询的静态分析器（例如CodeQL）将易受攻击的代码模式编码在检测查询中，并与源代码进行匹配。然而，现有查询仍然存在误报（FP，错误地将良性代码标记为易受攻击）和漏报（FN，遗漏真实漏洞）的问题。我们提出了ARQ，一个智能体框架，利用从合成的C/C++程序中获得的执行级证据自动优化C/C++ CodeQL查询。我们的关键见解是：当合成程序的执行结果与查询的判定不一致时，该程序便暴露了查询的弱点。如果程序确实易受攻击但查询保持沉默，则查询存在漏报弱点；如果程序安全但查询仍触发，则查询存在误报弱点。ARQ随后运行一个基于LLM的优化循环，利用这些不一致作为依据来修复查询。
tldr: ARQ通过利用合成程序执行结果与查询判定不一致的证据，自动修复CodeQL查询中的误报和漏报弱点，提升C/C++漏洞检测准确性。
en_tdlr: ARQ automatically repairs CodeQL queries by leveraging execution-grounded disagreements from synthesized programs to reduce false positives and false negatives in C/C++ vulnerability detection.
